title: HtmlRendererRequestV1
description: One bounded static-HTML-to-PDF render. The source is a file the platform already verified (size, hash, text/html ticket); the renderer preflights its content again and refuses anything that would need a network, a script or a host file.

content.description: Optional content selection: only the outermost elements of <body> matching the CSS selector are printed (placed directly under <body>, in source order; <head> and its styles stay). No match fails the render with CONTENT_NOT_FOUND; a selector Chromium cannot parse fails it with INVALID_INPUT. Absent: the whole document.
